ui.title: Apps for you
ui.subtitle: All apps are free to download on Google Play and can be used without creating an account. Your data is stored only on your device.

familtory.name: Familtory - Family Tree
familtory.tag: Build your family tree in minutes. Save it, back it up, and share it with family.
familtory.lead: A family tree app that's flexible, easy to use, and actually finished. No sign-in — your family's data never leaves the app.
feats: Start in a minute with a quick tutorial; one button tidies a tangled tree
Photos with cropping, birthdays, memorial dates, notes and themes
Stored only on your device — backup file to move to a new phone
Share as a high-res PNG; app lock with PIN, fingerprint or face

blinker.name: Blinker - Torch & Strobe
blinker.tag: Strobe from 0.1 to 60 Hz, record your own flash patterns, widget and Quick Settings tile.
blinker.lead: Your phone's torch turns on. That's it. Blinker lets you decide how it flashes.
feats: 0.1–60 flashes per second, plus steady, pulse, strobe and real Morse SOS
Hold REC to tap out a rhythm, trim it like a video, save it as a preset
Home-screen widget (down to 1×1) and a Quick Settings tile
Auto-off timer from 1 minute to 1 hour; keeps going with the screen locked

candle.name: Romantic Candle
candle.tag: Light a real-looking HD candle with one tap — anytime, anywhere.
candle.lead: A real candle in high definition, with no fire to worry about — for vigils, romantic evenings, prayer, birthdays or winding down.
feats: 20+ HD candle videos with color customization
Stays lit until you close the app — no wax, no smoke
Background music and 32 languages
No ads once the candle is lit. No account, no in-app purchases

fireplace.name: Night Fireplace - Cozy Fire HD
fireplace.tag: A night fireplace in high definition. Light it up and watch it burn, unlimited.
fireplace.lead: Cold winter nights, Christmas, setting the mood, or just staring into the fire — warmth with no smoke, no sparks, nothing to put out.
feats: HD fire with real crackling sound, burning until you close the app
A range of different fires to choose from
Plays offline — uses no data
No ads covering the fire. No sign-up, no permissions

sleepool.name: Sleepool - Cozy Noise
sleepool.tag: Rain, white noise and ASMR in your own mix. Sleep timer. Works offline.
sleepool.lead: Fill a room that is too quiet or too loud with a sound you build yourself. Set the timer, and it fades out on its own once you are asleep.
feats: 50+ sounds: rain, white/pink/brown noise, nature, ASMR, meditation, and everyday sounds like a fan or a café
A volume slider for every sound, saved mixes, and ready-made mixes to start from
Sleep timer from 15 minutes up to 12 hours, with a gentle fade-out at the end
Turn your own audio or video files into seamless loops. Works offline, no account

morserun.name: MorseRun - All-in-One Morse
morserun.tag: Talk in Morse code with your flashlight, read it with your camera. SOS built in.
morserun.lead: Point your camera at any blinking light and MorseRun reads it for you. Learn it, send it, decode it — one app covers the whole journey.
feats: Play: text → flashlight, screen flash, beep or vibration at 5–40 WPM
Decode: camera turns blinking light into text in real time, on-device
Learn: tap-to-hear Morse table and practice quizzes with streaks
SOS from the lock screen via Quick Settings tile — keeps going screen-off

homemo.name: Homemo: Notes Widget
homemo.tag: Pin your notes and photos to the home screen. Offline, no account needed.
homemo.lead: Write a note, add a photo, and place it as a widget — your shopping list, a reminder or a favorite photo, always one glance away.
feats: One widget per note — place as many as you like, resize freely
Style each widget: color, opacity, corners, text size and alignment
Notes with photos, color tags, pins, grid/list view and fast search
Fully offline, no login; 30-day trash and ZIP backup/restore

arcade.ds: Quick mini games right in your browser
